label: Survive the Storm
description: Navigate treacherous waters and weather devastating storms as you fight to keep your crew alive in the unforgiving Tempest Reef.

label: Build Your Fleet
description: Upgrade and customize your ships with powerful cannons, reinforced hulls, and mystical enhancements to dominate the seas.

label: Explore Mysterious Islands
description: Discover hidden treasures, ancient ruins, and dangerous creatures on uncharted islands scattered throughout the reef.

label: Form Alliances
description: Team up with other captains to take on powerful sea monsters, raid enemy strongholds, or engage in thrilling naval battles.

label: Dynamic Weather System
description: Experience realistic day-night cycles, unpredictable storms, and changing tides that affect gameplay and strategy.

label: Epic Boss Battles
description: Face off against legendary sea monsters and mythical creatures in intense boss fights that will test your skill and courage.
